{{Quote|We've spotted them, sir.|The scout to [[Steela Gerrera/Legends|Steela Gerrera]], upon seeing the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] entering the forest but unknown that was the Jedi|<ref name="AWOTF" />}}
A '''unnamed Onderon rebel''' lived on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] but when [[Sanjay Rash/Legends|Sanjay Rash]] affiliated with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], this individual joined the [[Onderon rebels/Legends|Onderon rebels]] to recapture the planet. The rebels called the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] for help, who dispatched to help them in training. When the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] arrived, the individual spotted the them and contacted Steela. Following their dropoff into Onderon's wilderness, the group meets one of the rebel leaders, [[Steela Gerrera/Legends|Steela Gerrera]], and are taken to the rebel base.<ref name="AWOTF" />

==Behind the scenes==
This Onderonian rebel scout was voiced by [[Matthew Wood]].<ref name="AWOTF" />
